main-window.description: The shipped meeting-notes window may run one local meeting flow: check readiness, request the two capture permissions, start and stop a meeting, save an operator note, and open local completed notes with their retained source passages. It cannot use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

preview-window.description: The local Preview build exercises the same single meeting-notes flow as the shipped window, including retained source passages for completed notes. It has no reference-interface, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

settings-window.description: The compact Settings window may show and request only the two local capture permissions. It cannot read meetings or use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.
